text: find the correct @"10_System/prompts/00 - Prompt Library Router.md" to fix and enrich 30_Library/100_zettelkasten/Impact of Set 2 Breakthroughs.md fix or remove the broken links and then enrich from the @"30_Library/100_zettelkasten/ notes

cmd: ls 10_System/prompts | grep -i "Note Refresh"; echo ---; cat "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/Impact of Set 2 Breakthroughs.md"; which shale
cat "10_System/prompts/Note Refresh & Link Auditor.md"; git diff --stat -- "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/Impact of Set 2 Breakthroughs.md"

git diff -- "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/Impact of Set 2 Breakthroughs.md" | head -60; for t in "Generative Intelligence" "Applicative Intelligence" "SoT - Generative Intelligence" "Kuhn's Four-Stage Model of Paradigm Collapse" "SoT - Conventional Problem Solving" "Fundamental Insight Creation"; do echo "== $t"; find . -name "$t.md" -not -path "./.git/*" | head; grep -rl --include=*.md -m1 -E "^aliases:.*$t" 30_Library 2>/dev/null | head -3; done; ls 30_Library/100_zettelkasten | grep -iE "applicative|generative|paradigm|insight|conventional|breakthrough|kuhn|normal science"

find . -iname "*applicative*" -not -path "./.git/*"; grep -rl "Applicative Intelligence" --include=*.md 30_Library | head; echo; head -30 "30_Library/SoT/SoT - Generative Intelligence.md"; grep -n "Impact of Set 2" -r 30_Library --include=*.md | head -5; cat "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/Paradigm Shifts Complete Through Generational Turnover, Not Persuasion.md" | head -25

title: Fix broken links and enrich Impact of Set 2 Breakthroughs per Note Refresh & Link Auditor
body: Remove unresolved [[Applicative Intelligence]] and redundant alias link [[Generative Intelligence]] (covered by SoT); add two annotated related Kuhn notes. Related-section/links only, no prose or proposition change.

cmd: shale intent "Fix broken links and enrich Impact of Set 2 Breakthroughs per Note Refresh & Link Auditor" --body "Remove unresolved [[Applicative Intelligence]] and redundant alias link [[Generative Intelligence]] (covered by SoT); add two annotated related Kuhn notes. Related-section/links only, no prose or proposition change."; head -22 "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/A Paradigm Only Collapses When a Viable Replacement Exists.md" | sed -n 1,22p; sed -n 6,16p "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/Kuhn's Incommensurability Thesis Denies Simple Cross-Paradigm Progress.md"

python3 - <<'EOF'
p="30_Library/100_zettelkasten/Impact of Set 2 Breakthroughs.md"
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("[[Generative Intelligence]]\n\n[[Applicative Intelligence]]\n\n","",1)
old="- [[Fundamental Insight Creation]]—_How a Set 2 breakthrough is produced, whereas this note covers what it enables afterwards._\n"
new=old+"- [[A Paradigm Only Collapses When a Viable Replacement Exists]]—_Explains why breakthroughs are rare: an old framework gives way only once a replacement both explains what it explained and resolves its anomalies._\n- [[Kuhn's Incommensurability Thesis Denies Simple Cross-Paradigm Progress]]—_A caution on the claim: if paradigms are incommensurable, the new fields a breakthrough opens are not simply an advance on what came before._\n"
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
open(p,"w").write(s)
EOF
uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/edge_lint.py --path "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/Impact of Set 2 Breakthroughs.md" 2>&1 | tail -8; uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/validate_note_shape.py "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/Impact of Set 2 Breakthroughs.md" 2>&1 | tail -5

note: Removed 2 unresolved/redundant links, added 2 annotated Kuhn related notes; edge_lint clean

cmd: uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/validate_note_shape.py --path "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/Impact of Set 2 Breakthroughs.md" 2>&1 | tail -6; shale done --note "Removed 2 unresolved/redundant links, added 2 annotated Kuhn related notes; edge_lint clean" --model claude-sonnet-5-5
